goals.objective: Commit the current complete working-tree snapshot first. Then implement support for Neo-tree file selection in lua/nvimcodex/lib/commands.lua. Preserve existing current-buffer and visual-selection context behavior. Add or extend focused tests for single selected file, multiple selected files, and no Neo-tree selection. Verify with the existing test suite, Lua diagnostics, and a real Neovim surface scenario that formats selected Neo-tree paths into the prompt. Commit the Neo-tree feature separately. Tier HEAVY: third-party file explorer integration. Stop when both commits exist, focused tests and diagnostics pass, and a real surface scenario shows selected paths in prompt context.

successCriteria.scenario: Before changing any feature code, run `git status --short`, `git diff --check HEAD`, then stage and commit the complete current worktree. PASS only if the baseline commit exists, its tree exactly matches the pre-feature working tree, and git status has no pending user changes. This criterion has no RED behavior proof because it checkpoints existing user-authored code; capture exact git status plus `git show --stat --oneline HEAD` to .omo/evidence/ulw/01a0c727-8fe7-7ca2-928a-9b8f78d50168/G001/C001-baseline.txt.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Saved pre-feature status and diff-check; commit SHA and `git show --stat`; post-commit status showing clean before feature edits.

successCriteria.scenario: Write focused tests for single and multiple Neo-tree selections that call the same selection adapter/context path used by `commands.format`; capture the expected assertion failing on the baseline before implementation, then passing after. Run a real Neovim usage scenario that populates Neo-tree selected nodes and invokes NvimCodex send; PASS only if the resulting prompt includes every selected relative path. Save RED/GREEN output and a prompt transcript under .omo/evidence/ulw/01a0c727-8fe7-7ca2-928a-9b8f78d50168/G001/C002-*.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Captured failing-first unit assertion, passing focused test output, and real Neovim/Neo-tree prompt transcript proving one and multiple selected paths.

successCriteria.scenario: Run focused empty-selection, regular-buffer, and visual-range prompt formatting scenarios. PASS only if no Neo-tree selection leaves ordinary context unchanged and existing current-buffer/visual-selection formatting remains intact; save the exact test output under .omo/evidence/ulw/01a0c727-8fe7-7ca2-928a-9b8f78d50168/G001/C003-regression.txt.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Passing test output for empty selection and current buffer/visual range; regression output captured after implementation.

codexObjective: Complete the durable ulw-loop plan in .omo/ulw-loop/01a0c727-8fe7-7ca2-928a-9b8f78d50168/goals.json, including later accepted/appended stories, under the original brief constraints; use .omo/ulw-loop/01a0c727-8fe7-7ca2-928a-9b8f78d50168/ledger.jsonl as the audit trail.
